articles.title: Pressure-regulated mechanochemistry at lithium metal-sulfide electrolyte interfaces
articles.selectionReason: Open full-text paper; topic energy; quality signal passed; application scenario is clear.

paperCard.problem: 全固态锂金属电池中，锂金属和硫化物电解质接触时容易发生副反应，生成不稳定界面层，导致电池性能变差。人们通常只把叠压压力当作维持接触的工具，却不知道压力本身会不会改变界面化学反应。
paperCard.method: 作者用考虑了压力作用、能分辨电荷的机器学习分子动力学模型，并和密度泛函理论计算做对照，来模拟不同压力大小和加载方向下锂与Li6PS5Cl电解质界面的分解和结晶过程。
paperCard.difference: 之前的研究多关注材料成分或温度对界面反应的影响，而这项工作系统考察压力大小和加载方式，并发现反应存在一个非单调的‘压力窗口’：中等压力加速分解，高压反而抑制分解。
paperCard.innovation: 创新点在于把机械压力作为调节界面化学的主动开关，并利用高精度的机器学习模型揭示出非直觉的非单调压力效应，而不是只把压力当作改善物理接触的工装条件。
paperCard.implementation: 具体实现上，他们开发了压力感知且电荷分辨的机器学习力场，用分子动力学模拟Li/Li6PS5Cl界面在不同外加静水压(如1 kbar、10–100 kbar)下的结构演化，再用DFT校验，分析PS4四面体的分解程度和Li2S团簇的生成与有序化情况。
paperCard.applications: 可应用于全固态电池的电芯设计，如选择合适的外加压力窗口或通过弹性夹具调控界面稳定性；也可指导界面保护层设计，为其他固态电解质体系的力学-化学耦合研究提供方法。
technicalTerms: 机械化学：利用机械力（如压力、摩擦）引发的化学反应或结构变化。
Li6PS5Cl：一种硫化物固态电解质材料。
PS4：电解质中的四硫代磷酸根阴离子，其分解常导致界面副产物生成。
机器学习分子动力学：用机器学习模型替代传统数值计算来高效模拟原子运动。
DFT：密度泛函理论，一种量子力学计算方法，用作精度标准。
堆叠压力：电池组装时对电芯施加的外部机械压力。
非单调响应：随着压力增大，反应先变快后变慢，并非线性变化。

articles.highlight: 压缩响应是非单调的：1 kbar时加速PS4分解和Li2S式有序化，10–100 kbar时抑制结构重排与长程结晶。
articles.summary: 这项研究用压力感知的机器学习分子动力学模拟，揭示了在全固态锂金属电池中，堆叠压力不仅维持接触，还会改变锂金属与硫化物电解质界面的化学反应。研究发现压力对界面相形成的影响不是线性的，这为设计更稳定的电池界面提供了新思路。值得一读是因为它把力学因素与电化学界面化学联系起来，补充了传统只看材料成分的思路。
articles.failureAnalysis: 目前证据主要来自机器学习分子动力学模拟，缺乏大规模实验验证；且论文尚未经同行评审，可信度需进一步确认。实际电池中压力分布不均，简单的各向同性压力设定可能与真实工况有差距。
articles.sourceExcerpt: 1 Pressure-regulated mechanochemistry at lithium metal–sulﬁde electrolyte interfaces Kunik Jang1, Jaehwan Choi1, Jang Wook Choi1,2,3, and Yousung Jung1,4* 1 Department of Chemical and Biological Engineering (BK21 four), and Institute of Chemical Processes, Seoul National University, 1 Gwanak-ro, Gwanak-gu, Seoul 08826, Korea 2 Institute for Battery Research Innovation (IBRI), Seoul National University, 1 Gwanak-ro, Gwanak-gu, Seoul 08826, Korea 3 Seoul National University Energy Initiative (SNUEI), Seoul National University, 1 Gwanak-ro, Gwanak-gu, Seoul 08826, Korea 4 Institute of Engineering Research, Seoul National University, 1 Gwanak-ro, Gwanak-gu, Seoul 08826, Korea * Email: yousung.jung@snu.ac.kr Abstract Stack pressure is commonly treated as a means of maintaining physical contact in all-solid-state lithium-metal batteries, but it can also alter the chemistry of reactive solid–solid interfaces. Here, using pressure-aware, charge-resolved machine-learning molecular dynamics validated against DFT, we determine how pressure magnitude and loading geometry regulate interphase formation at Li||Li6PS5Cl interfaces. The response is nonmonotonic: compression at 1 kbar accelerates PS4 decomposition and Li2S-like ordering, whereas 10–100 kbar compression restricts structural rearrangement and long-range crystallization.

zh.title: 压力调控的锂金属-硫化物电解质界面的机械化学过程

paperCard.problem: 全固态锂金属电池中，锂金属和硫化物电解质接触时容易发生副反应，生成不稳定界面层，导致电池性能变差。人们通常只把叠压压力当作维持接触的工具，却不知道压力本身会不会改变界面化学反应。
paperCard.method: 作者用考虑了压力作用、能分辨电荷的机器学习分子动力学模型，并和密度泛函理论计算做对照，来模拟不同压力大小和加载方向下锂与Li6PS5Cl电解质界面的分解和结晶过程。
paperCard.difference: 之前的研究多关注材料成分或温度对界面反应的影响，而这项工作系统考察压力大小和加载方式，并发现反应存在一个非单调的‘压力窗口’：中等压力加速分解，高压反而抑制分解。
paperCard.innovation: 创新点在于把机械压力作为调节界面化学的主动开关，并利用高精度的机器学习模型揭示出非直觉的非单调压力效应，而不是只把压力当作改善物理接触的工装条件。
paperCard.implementation: 具体实现上，他们开发了压力感知且电荷分辨的机器学习力场，用分子动力学模拟Li/Li6PS5Cl界面在不同外加静水压(如1 kbar、10–100 kbar)下的结构演化，再用DFT校验，分析PS4四面体的分解程度和Li2S团簇的生成与有序化情况。
paperCard.applications: 可应用于全固态电池的电芯设计，如选择合适的外加压力窗口或通过弹性夹具调控界面稳定性；也可指导界面保护层设计，为其他固态电解质体系的力学-化学耦合研究提供方法。
technicalTerms: 机械化学：利用机械力（如压力、摩擦）引发的化学反应或结构变化。
Li6PS5Cl：一种硫化物固态电解质材料。
PS4：电解质中的四硫代磷酸根阴离子，其分解常导致界面副产物生成。
机器学习分子动力学：用机器学习模型替代传统数值计算来高效模拟原子运动。
DFT：密度泛函理论，一种量子力学计算方法，用作精度标准。
堆叠压力：电池组装时对电芯施加的外部机械压力。
非单调响应：随着压力增大，反应先变快后变慢，并非线性变化。

en.highlight: The response is nonmonotonic: compression at 1 kbar accelerates PS4 decomposition and Li2S-like ordering, whereas 10–100 kbar compression restricts structural rearrangement and long-range crystallization.
en.summary: This study uses pressure-aware, charge-resolved machine-learning molecular dynamics to show that stack pressure not only maintains contact but also alters interfacial chemistry between lithium metal and sulfide electrolytes. The nonmonotonic pressure response suggests optimal pressure windows for stable all-solid-state batteries. It is worth reading because it links mechanical stress to electrochemical interface chemistry, going beyond traditional composition-focused studies.
en.failureAnalysis: Key evidence is based on simulations rather than direct experiments, and the paper is a preprint that has not yet undergone peer review. Real battery pressure distributions are heterogeneous, so idealized pressure conditions may not fully capture practical operating states.
en.title: Pressure-regulated mechanochemistry at lithium metal–sulfide electrolyte interfaces

paperCard.problem: In all-solid-state lithium-metal batteries, the interface between lithium metal and sulfide electrolytes degrades due to side reactions. Pressure is usually viewed only as a way to maintain physical contact, and its chemical effect on interfacial decomposition is unclear.
paperCard.method: The authors simulate the Li/Li6PS5Cl interface under various pressures using machine-learned molecular dynamics with charge resolution, validated against density functional theory. They then analyze how pressure magnitude and loading geometry affect PS4 decomposition and Li2S ordering.
paperCard.difference: Instead of focusing only on material composition or temperature, this work systematically studies pressure as a chemical variable and reveals an unexpected nonmonotonic trend where moderate pressure worsens decomposition but very high pressure suppresses it.
paperCard.innovation: The innovation is treating pressure as an active tuner of interfacial chemistry and using high-accuracy machine-learned dynamics to reveal counterintuitive pressure effects, rather than treating pressure as a purely physical contact aid.
paperCard.implementation: They develop a pressure-aware, charge-resolved machine-learning force field, run molecular dynamics on the Li/Li6PS5Cl interface with applied hydrostatic pressures (e.g., 1 kbar and 10–100 kbar), and benchmark results against DFT. They track the degree of PS4 tetrahedral decomposition and the ordering of Li2S-like clusters.
paperCard.applications: This can guide stack-pressure design in all-solid-state batteries, help optimize cell assembly fixtures, and provide modeling frameworks for studying mechanochemical effects in other electrochemical interfaces.
technicalTerms: Mechanochemistry: chemistry induced or altered by mechanical force such as pressure or grinding.
Li6PS5Cl: a sulfide solid electrolyte material.
PS4: thiophosphate polyanion in the electrolyte, whose decomposition often causes interfacial side products.
Machine-learning molecular dynamics: atomistic simulation that uses a machine-learning model to compute forces efficiently.
DFT: density functional theory, a quantum chemistry method used as a benchmark.
Stack pressure: external applied pressure on the battery stack.
Nonmonotonic response: a response that is not linear, e.g., increasing pressure first accelerates then suppresses a reaction.

articles.title: diudiu-tech/delivery-harness
articles.selectionReason: AI source passed freshness and evidence-chain gate: GitHub + Community signal
articles.summary: 这是一个GitHub上获得1324星的开源仓库，描述为按需配送工作流的AI harness参考实现。它给开发即时配送、本地生活履约系统的工程师提供了一套可借鉴的AI集成范式和落地代码。关注AI落地的人可以通过它理解harness层如何衔接模型与复杂业务环境。
articles.failureAnalysis: 项目仍是参考实现，缺少真实配送环境中的运力调度、定价和时效博弈闭环，直接套用风险高。配送场景强依赖线下数据、城市路网与实时订单流，开源代码很难自带可用的生产级数据与仿真环境。实际落地会遇到合规、责任归属和骑手/商家利益冲突，单一harness参考难以解决交付链路的多方博弈问题。

en.highlight: An AI harness reference implementation for on-demand delivery workflows, showing how to embed AI into instant-fulfillment business processes.
en.summary: This GitHub repo with 1,324 stars is an open-source reference implementation of an AI harness for on-demand delivery workflows. It provides engineers building instant-delivery and local-life fulfillment systems with a reusable AI integration pattern and example code. It is useful for understanding how a harness layer connects models to complex business environments.
en.failureAnalysis: This is only a reference implementation; real delivery requires closed-loop control over fleet dispatch, pricing, and deadlines, which is hard to replicate. Production deployment also depends on proprietary data, city-wide simulation, regulation, and multi-party incentives that a single open-source harness cannot address.
